title: Maurice Durand's visit and a California trip
summary: Maurice Durand came down unannounced; Russell and Manetta visited him in California.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yeah. Maurice Duran was down here a week before last or?
Oh, he was. We didn't know that. I didn't know it.

He'd come tell me he was asking for me, but I didn't know nothing until he was gone back. Well, he lives way down the Ninth Ward. Yeah. Flood Street. Yeah, no way. But I mean he was gone when I found out he was asking for me. Nobody didn't tell him how to get in touch with me.
Well, last year Professor Manetta and I went to see him in California. Yeah, California. He went to his home out there. He's big and fat yet they told me.
